svg.title: Pirate City — whole north-bank planning review
svg.desc: Measured Minecraft shoreline with proposed dense west and east building layouts, narrow alleys, retained landmarks, bridge and western zipline landing. City rebuilding is held for owner review. This is a planning drawing, not a screenshot or finished-world claim.

svg.text: Whole north-bank planning map / DRAFT FOR YOUR REVIEW
Buildings fill the districts; crooked narrow alleys connect them. The river stays open.
Muted timber, stone and clay palette throughout; map colors distinguish planning layers.
Planning drawing only. Unresolved stepped links and shorefront infill need refinement before rebuilding.
